name: assistant
title: Assistant
description: Full-page assistant laid out by the kai-workspace shell: the kai-conversations rail (built-in header, search and New chat) in the start aside, with the resize handle between the columns, a collapse the shell performs so main reflows, and an overlay drawer below the breakpoint. Every rail row carries its own menu, opened from the kebab where the timestamp sits, read in three groups by dividers and closing with the one item that cannot act. The rail's footer is a row: a placeholder identity menu with a menu of its own, and a settings gear beside it whose theme choice (Light, Dark or System) switches the block's own scheme. Main carries the kai-model-switcher recipe in its top bar, kai-thread, and a kai-prompt-input with slash and at entity triggers and a voice path into kai-voice-input. Ships with a scripted mock so the thread demos reasoning, a settled tool call and citations on first paint.
docs: Runs against a scripted local mock out of the box - no endpoint, no key. The transport is one file, assistant.transport.ts: the scripted mock in the default mode, a POST to /api/chat with --gateway, a loud stub with --no-mock. Replace it with your own to go live, and keep parsing through the @kitn.ai/ui/wire readers. A rail row's menu opens from the kebab beside its timestamp, reads in three groups (things you would supply, things this block does, things it cannot undo) and closes with Delete; Share is inert on purpose, because it needs a share endpoint you own, so it is disabled with the reason in a tooltip rather than a live-looking no-op. The foot of the rail is a row of two menus: the identity menu is a placeholder (Demo User, Demo plan) with one item that works and one disabled row saying that account screens belong to your app, and the settings gear beside it carries the theme choice, Light, Dark or System, which switches the whole block's own scheme through the kit's per-element theme attribute. Nothing about the choice is persisted: a reload starts on System. Keyboard: F2 renames the open conversation, Cmd+Shift+P (Ctrl+Shift+P elsewhere) pins it, Cmd+Shift+A archives it; Cmd+R and Cmd+P are left to the browser. The composer takes slash and at entity triggers from sample lists you delete (an at mention is the kit's agent kind, so the pill carries the at sigil), its mic drives kai-voice-input, whose transcript lands in the prompt with focus left in the composer, and the thread shows a scroll to bottom button once you scroll away from the bottom.
